rices.name: Aperture
rices.author: Ryoku Team
rices.summary: A crisp, brutalist instrument. Square corners, tight gaps, a hard-edged frame…
rices.description: A crisp, brutalist instrument. Square corners, tight gaps, a hard-edged frame and no glass; colours track your wallpaper through matugen, so any wall becomes a sharp technical desktop.
rices.blurb: A crisp, brutalist instrument. Square corners, tight gaps, a hard-edged frame and no glass; colours track your wallpaper through matugen, so any wall becomes a sharp technical desktop.
